basic_info.description: Nestled within the prestigious Ashbury Heights neighborhood, 224 Downey epitomizes the style and elegance of the Victorian era. Built at the turn of the century, the light-filled home seamlessly integrates the indoor and outdoor living moments that are so quintessentially California. The main floor is set-up for entertaining, featuring a living room, family room, dining area and expansive eat-in kitchen that leads directly out to your sun-filled backyard. The main level also includes one of the three bedrooms and a full bathroom. Upstairs, the two oversized bedrooms and spa bathroom benefit from skylights and western views. The lower level features a home office with separate entrance, an insulated wine storage area and direct access to your garage. Flooded with natural light, the private backyard enjoys multiple entertaining areas, mature trees and plants, creating a calming respite in the heart of the city. The perfect balance of modern amenities with timeless architectural details creates an unparalleled sanctuary for refined living. Walking distance to stores and restaurants of Cole Valley, public transportation and schools like The Lycee Francais.
